lead: ZCZC NFDTCDAT3 ALL TTAA00 KWNH DDHHMM Post-Tropical Cyclone Chantal Discussion Number 14 NWS Weather Prediction Center College Park MD AL032025 1100 PM EDT Mon Jul 07 2025 Key Messages: 1. Heavy rainfall from Post-Tropical Cyclone Chantal is possible as it brushes by New Jersey, Long Island, Cape Cod, Martha's Vineyard, and Nantucket. Due to its increasing forward speed, any flash flooding would be isolated. 2. Life-threatening surf and rip currents conditions are expected to continue at beaches along the U.S. East Coast from northeastern Florida to the Mid-Atlantic states during the next day or so. Beach goers should heed the advice of lifeguards and local officials.
